hypothesis: Using the same frozen global reference policy in fit and held-out removes artificial history-availability reconstruction error; detection improvement is not assumed.
changed_factor: History reference availability only. No labels, splits, day cohorts, architecture, hyperparameters, threshold grid or selection objective change.

cv.fitting: refit every profile/vocabulary/scaler and model on inner fit only; epoch/threshold on inner calibration only; frozen evaluation on outer assessment

threshold_selection: validation F1, recall, lower FPR, lower threshold; LSTM epoch F1/recall/FPR with earliest exact tie
comparison: Report both policies and every model seed; mean/sample-std/min/max and paired seed differences. No seed selection or deletion of bad runs.
cv_interpretation: Three dependent outer folds test sensitivity to unseen account groups; scenario 3 has only one primary-train group and cannot support all sides of every fold.
test_policy: No real test scoring, prediction inspection, threshold calibration or model selection in step 3. Final remains a separate step.
freeze: Persist immutable record binding every completed full candidate, checkpoint/config hash and threshold before any real final evaluation.
